info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Disputes-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Dispute Management API enables users to list payment disputes effectively. This endpoint provides critical insights into disputes related to payments, allowing businesses to identify and manage unresolved issues efficiently. Typical consumers include customer support teams and financial analysts who monitor transaction integrity and resolve conflicts. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their operational workflows related to payment dispute resolution.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific payment dispute, providing relevant information such as the dispute status, associated transactions, and any related comments or evidence.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to a payment dispute. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the dispute query.
